title: KLETC's 362nd Basic Training Class graduates on 25th anniversary of 9/11
summary_en: Seventeen officers graduated from the Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center on Sept. 11. Members of the 362nd Basic Training Class will go on to serve in communities throughout the state.
title_cn: KLETC's 362nd Basic Training Class graduates on 25th anniversary of 9/11

title: Law Review Symposium to discuss voting rights
summary_en: On Oct. 9, the Kansas Law Review’s 2026 Symposium will bring together leading academics and practitioners to explore the impact of the recent Louisiana v. Callais decision on voting rights legislation and litigation across the country.
title_cn: Law Review Symposium to discuss voting rights

title: KU to host series of informational meetings for students with intellectual disabilities, parents and educators
summary_en: The University of Kansas Transition to Postsecondary Education program (KU TPE) is hosting a series of informational meetings in several Kansas cities in October and November. KU TPE is a two-year, fully inclusive undergraduate certificate program at the Lawrence campus.
title_cn: KU to host series of informational meetings for students with intellectual disabilities, parents and educators

title: KU Extended Learning relaunches in-person Lean Six Sigma Black Belt course
summary_en: KU will offer its Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification course at the KU Edwards Campus in Overland Park on Oct. 5, 19 and Nov. 2. Instructor Heather McCain will offer a free one-hour webinar Sept. 23 to cover course concepts.
title_cn: KU Extended Learning relaunches in-person Lean Six Sigma Black Belt course
